headline: Certified Accountant (Contabilista Certificado)
summary: Accountant with over three years of experience in general accounting and tax compliance within an industrial company. Holds an active registration with the Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC - Portuguese Chartered Accountants Association) and a Licenciatura (bachelor's degree) in Accounting and Administration. Experienced in routine bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, and preparing periodic tax declarations under the Portuguese Accounting Standards System (SNC).

experience.title: Certified Accountant
experience.employer: Metalúrgica do Vale do Ave, Lda.
bullets: Perform daily accounting bookings and document classification in accordance with the Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (SNC).
Prepare and submit periodic tax declarations including VAT (IVA), corporate income tax (IRC), and personal income tax withholdings (IRS).
Execute monthly bank reconciliations and monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Support the preparation of annual financial statements and closing of accounts.
